items.exampleEn: The singer made her TV debut at the age of sixteen.
items.exampleZh: 那位歌手十六歲時首次在電視上亮相。
items.glossZh: 首次亮相、初次登場；首次推出

items.exampleEn: My friend plays guitar at weekend gigs to earn extra money.
items.exampleZh: 我朋友週末去演出場合彈吉他，賺點外快。

items.exampleEn: The sequel was even more popular than the first film.
items.exampleZh: 續集甚至比第一部電影更受歡迎。

items.exampleEn: The summer blockbuster earned millions in its first week.
items.exampleZh: 那部暑期強檔大片首週就賺進數百萬。

items.exampleEn: She wrote the screenplay in only three months.
items.exampleZh: 她只花了三個月就寫完電影劇本。

items.exampleEn: The salesperson gave us a quick demo of the new phone.
items.exampleZh: 店員為我們快速示範了新手機的功能。

items.sentenceEn: Fans have waited five years for the sequel.
items.sentenceZh: 粉絲們等續集已經等了五年。

items.audioEn: I can't come on Saturday because I have a gig with my band.
items.audioZh: 我星期六不能來，因為我要和樂團一起演出。
items.questionZh: 說話者星期六為什麼不能來？

items.sentenceEn: Every summer, movie theaters are full of blockbusters.
items.sentenceZh: 每年夏天，電影院都擠滿了強檔大片。

items.sentenceEn: The band's first demo sounded rough but exciting.
items.sentenceZh: 樂團的第一張試聽帶聽起來粗糙，卻很令人興奮。

items.stemEn: The actors read the ____ together before filming began.
items.stemZh: 開拍前，演員們一起讀了劇本。

items.stemEn: The young actor will ____ in a new musical next month.
items.stemZh: 那位年輕演員下個月將在一齣新音樂劇中首次登台。

items.passageEn: Five years ago, the band Lumo played small gigs in cafes and recorded a demo in a friend's bedroom. A film director heard the demo and asked them to write music for his new movie. The film became a surprise blockbuster, and the band's song was a number-one hit within a week of its debut. Now the director is working on a sequel, and the band's singer, Nadia, has even helped with the screenplay. She says success has not changed them: they still play one free show in a cafe every month.
items.passageZh: 五年前，Lumo 樂團還在咖啡館做小型演出，並在朋友的臥室錄了一張試聽帶。一位電影導演聽到這張試聽帶後，請他們為他的新電影寫配樂。這部電影意外成為賣座大片，樂團的歌推出不到一週就登上排行榜第一名。現在導演正在拍續集，樂團主唱 Nadia 甚至幫忙寫了劇本。她說成功並沒有改變他們：他們每個月仍會在咖啡館免費演出一場。

questions.questionZh: 導演為什麼找上這個樂團？
options: 樂團主唱是他的老朋友
他聽到了他們在臥室錄的試聽帶

questions.questionZh: Nadia 說他們現在仍會做什麼？
options: 在朋友的臥室錄新的試聽帶
每年為導演的新電影寫歌
每月在咖啡館免費演出

items.promptZh: 這位作家的第一本小說去年出版，非常成功。
referenceEn: The writer's debut novel came out last year and was a big success.
Her debut novel, published last year, was very successful.
rubricZh: debut 可當名詞或修飾名詞，表示「初次登場、首部作品」（例如 a debut novel、make a debut 等）
「出版」可寫，例如 came out、was published 等
「非常成功」可寫，例如 was a big success、was very successful 等

items.promptZh: 這家遊戲公司正在開發那款熱門遊戲的續集。
referenceEn: The game company is developing a sequel to that popular game.
The game company is working on a sequel to that popular game.
rubricZh: 「續集」用 sequel（例如 a sequel to that popular game 等）
「開發」可寫，例如 developing、working on、making 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：干擾項 sauna／canoe／plaque 與「新電影的___花了兩位編劇一整年」語意完全無關，一眼排除（§11-26）；四選項同詞性的「靠詞義判斷」題失去鑑別力。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 干擾項換成藝文休閒情境的已教名詞 darkroom、devotee、billiards，只看英文時代入都不通

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似：樂團名 "Blue Door" 由兩個英文單字組成，比照 §11-10（Green、Tiger 寵物名）宜換成非單字專名。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 樂團名 Blue Door 改 Lumo；主唱 Lily（一般單字）改 Nadia；中譯保留英文名

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似："My cousin" 譯「我表哥」多加了性別、長幼與父系／母系資訊（§11-20）；建議「我的表親」或英文改寫。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 例句改 My friend，中譯「我朋友」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 B 疑似 14：screenplay 卡與 mcq 都是「寫劇本花多久」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 題幹改 The actors read the ____ together before filming began.

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：debut 可當名詞或修飾名詞，表示「初次登場、首部作品」（例如 a debut novel、make a debut 等）／「出版」可寫，例如 came out、was published 等／「非常成功」可寫，例如 was a big success、was very successful 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：sequel 是可數名詞，表示「續集」，用法例如 a sequel to…、the sequel 等／句子要說到你自己的喜好

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（sequel）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id c1-u30-l01-q15；目標字沿用 sequel
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 translate：promptZh「這家遊戲公司正在開發那款熱門遊戲的續集。」、hintWords ["sequel"]、referenceEn ["The game company is developing a sequel to that popular game.","The game company is working on a sequel to that popular game."]、rubricZh ["「續集」用 sequel（例如 a sequel to that popular game 等）","「開發」可寫，例如 developing、working on、making 等"]（原 makeSentence：instructionZh「用 sequel 造一個句子，說說你希望哪部電影或小說出續集。」、referenceEn ["I hope there will be a sequel to my favorite cartoon.","I want to read the sequel to the book I finished last week."]）
